profile.name: Akhil Kumar

profile.blurb: I design AI-driven digital products and customer experiences — 16+ years across UI/UX, Product Design, CX, and Front-End Development. I lead end-to-end product experiences across e-commerce, retail, marketplaces, mobile apps, and enterprise platforms, connecting UX, CX, AI, and technology from customer journey to production.

about.lead: I design AI-driven digital products and customer experiences that turn complex business challenges into simple, scalable, and high-performing experiences.
paragraphs: With 16+ years of experience across UI/UX, Product Design, CX, and Front-End Development, I lead end-to-end product experiences across e-commerce, retail, marketplaces, mobile apps, and enterprise platforms.
My strength is connecting UX + CX + AI + technology — from customer journeys, product strategy, information architecture and user flows to design systems, prototyping and production.
I start with the customer and business problem, not just the interface. I simplify complex workflows and translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, scalable experiences.
I use Generative AI, AI UX, AI-assisted design and vibe coding throughout the product lifecycle, from research and ideation to prototyping and front-end implementation.
delivers: AI-enabled experiences, conversational interfaces, intelligent search, recommendations, personalization, content generation and AI-assisted workflows
UX strategy, user research, customer journey mapping, information architecture, user flows, interaction design, usability testing and conversion optimization
Scalable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, accessibility (WCAG) and multi-platform consistency
E-commerce, marketplaces, PIM, OMS, catalog, seller platforms, customer portals, checkout, promotions, loyalty and growth experiences
Rapid ideation, prototyping, UI generation, design exploration and faster design-to-development workflows
React, Next.js and React Native, enabling strong collaboration with engineering teams

process.title: Research & Discovery
process.body: Start with the business goal and the user. Stakeholder interviews, competitive teardown, analytics, and AI-assisted synthesis to find where the real friction is.

process.title: Define & Map
process.body: Turn findings into clarity — personas, jobs-to-be-done, and end-to-end customer journeys that align product, CX, and engineering on what to build and why.

process.title: Design & Systemize
process.body: Wireframes to high-fidelity flows in Figma, built on a scalable design system so patterns stay consistent, accessible, and fast to ship across web and mobile.

process.title: Prototype & Validate
process.body: Interactive prototypes and usability testing to de-risk decisions early. AI-powered ideation to explore more directions in less time.

process.title: Build & Handoff
process.body: Hands-on front-end in React, Next.js, and React Native — I bridge design and code, so quality holds from concept through production with a clean handoff.
